exposure: Primary Antiphospholipid Syndrome (APS) in pregnant women with DVT
Negative Antiphospholipid Antibodies (aPLs) in pregnant women with DVT
cohort: The study included 171 pregnant patients (39 with primary APS and DVT, 132 with DVT and negative aPL results) who received prenatal care for autoimmunity and thrombophilia.
finding: Patients with primary APS and DVT have adverse obstetric outcomes despite appropriate treatment, whereas those with DVT and negative aPLs have favorable results.
